method: Actual product IPC import and UI edit/open/export; preview surface and native painted window capture versus independently FFmpeg-decoded exported MP4. No original-application equivalence claim.
limits: Patch interiors avoid chroma subsampling boundaries; this test does not certify every pixel or every timeline feature.
Source color assumptions are product policy; previews are compared with outputs, not with unchanged pre-transfer RGB source numbers.
No HDR fixture, no display calibration, no long-project stress.
